distribution_scope: Release license obligations apply to the runtime closure of requirements/environment.lock.json; prohibited licenses are rejected in every group.
rules: Permissive license metadata can make a packaged dependency eligible for activation; it does not by itself authorize source adaptation; bounded incorporation requires a separate adaptation review.
Mixed-license repositories are scoped by path; enterprise or separately licensed directories are excluded unless independently approved.
MPL dependencies require notice and file-level compliance review before activation or distribution.
Unasserted, unknown, source-available, reciprocal, or custom licenses require explicit human legal approval for the affected use.
Every activated dependency must record a pinned version or digest, notices, vulnerability evidence, compatibility tests, SBOM coverage, and rollback.
Mined architecture and test ideas must be independently implemented without copied source unless a separate adaptation review authorizes exact files, paths, notices, hashes, and tests.
Approved bounded source adaptations require an exact upstream revision, source path, Project Pipeline path, content hash, notice path, and behavioral test evidence.
